text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Lately, there's a student I've been curious about.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: That's why I think—wouldn't it be better if we didn't lock in their career paths too early, and instead gave students an environment where they can envision a broader horizon?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
If we map out a roadmap incorporating overseas challenges early on,
and adopt international methodologies into our training――

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
That would broaden the potential paths she can take in the future.
The issue, however, is finding the time...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Doing absolutely everything would prove difficult.
...However, there are methods that allow them to coexist. If we build our plan around those, perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Yeah! So I was hoping to get some menu advice from the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Implementing an advanced curriculum, is it?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Yep♪ In schools overseas, some places reduce general academic hours for scholarship students to teach specialized race theory instead—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking, if we incorporate that,
maybe Japanese Umamusume can push their limits even higher, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That is true... However, it would also mean the Academy itself
is taking the initiative to provide an opportunity
that could create an insurmountable gap between students.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...If it is offered strictly as an elective, open to anyone,
it might be worth proposing to the Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, mm-hmm... Thanks for the feedback!
I'll put together the proposal and submit it~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――And though she is merely a student, she actively exchanges opinions with adults, wishing for the racing world's progress with a broad perspective set on the international stage.
choice_data_list: ...I'd love to sit down and have a long chat sometime.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are~
Got a second to talk?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: For real? Now I'm super curious! Tell me about that first♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
—I see.
So that's why you were so curious about me.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Well, ain't nothin' wrong with a student talkin' like this with adults!
To get a huge project rollin', lookin' at the big picture from up high is totally a must, right?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Yep, my future! I've got the vision locked down, and right now I'm basically mapping out the roadmap!
choice_data_list: So you're learning from all over for the sake of your future?
You have a dream you want to fulfill, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
That's it!
I just really want to take in as much info as possible.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Following my dad all over the place back in the day gave me
the knowledge that makes me who I am today, right?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: I'd love to chat with all sorts of people at Tracen Academy and broaden my horizons.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Thaaaat's why I wanna chat, okay?
Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
You're someone I've got my eye on.
Come on, let's have a fruitful exchange of ideas♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
You're someone I've got my eye on, after all.
Come on, let's have a fruitful exchange of ideas♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe "dream" isn't the right word?
Since making it come true is already a given, after all.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
In spirit, I'd say it's pretty close to a PJ.
Packed with my ultimate ambition—
a super-flashy innovation!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna hit 'em with something massive, so keep your eyes on me, Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: A-n-d, I'm really looking forward to your project too, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: A-n-d, I'm really looking forward to your project too, okay?♪
